_note: Room.svelte format for room id 'products-hero' (L5, the Products hero backdrop). Normalised 0..1 of the plate, origin top-left. points.hero_ref_tl/br = where ref3's hero (screen x 160..1222, y 0..311) sits inside the plate: the plate adds a ~10 % safe margin on every side, so a box of the hero's own shape shows the room ~17 % smaller than the mockup unless it is scaled to that frame (see README). points.character = bottom-centre of the (empty) character slot; the slot is kept clean. surfaces.quote = axis-aligned box of the handwritten quote over the window (rotate the text -10 deg inside it). 'cameras.products_hero' keeps the Blender job's anchors verbatim.

products_hero.coords: normalised plate coordinates (0..1), origin top-left, x right, y down

refFrame.note: ref3 hero (screen x 160..1222, y 0..311) inside this plate

character.note: kept clean for the SVG character holding the jar (ref3 screen x 640..965)

quote.note: axis-aligned bbox of the quote block; rotate -10deg

masks._doc: Living-room masks for animating the plate (scripts/blender/mask_passes.py + mask_post.py). Same pixel grid as the plate (normalised coordinates are shared). Data maps, NOT plates: never stack them as pictures. Lossless 8-bit WebP (value = byte / 255, ids exact); depth is lossy. See the room README.

plants.g: screen-space sway weight: (distance from the plant base / its camera depth) / swayScale; 0 at the pot .. 1 at the most mobile leaf tip in the scene; feathered to 0 at featherPx outside the silhouette
plants.b: plant id / 255 (plants[].id), 0 outside the feather zone

lamps.g: lamp id / 255 (lights[].id) on the fixture and its halo zone

depth.note: 0 = 0.5 m .. 1 = 12.5 m from the camera (linear mist pass of the mask render)
